attr.title: Endacopia
attr.desc:
Endacopia (Andyland, 2026) running natively on aarch64 through the Adventure Game Studio engine, built for OpenGL ES so it renders on the Mali GPU rather than falling back to software.

This port does not include the game: its files come from your own copy.

The game renders at 384x216, so on a 4:3 panel it fills the width and letterboxes. The left stick and the d-pad walk, the right stick moves the pointer, and A and B are left and right click. The shoulder buttons double those two up, because the fights are played with the pointer and need both hands' worth of buttons within reach.
attr.inst:
This port does NOT include the game. Copy Endacopia.ags, audio.vox and sp_speechsounds.vox from the Data folder of your own copy of Endacopia into ports/endacopia/.

On Steam those three files are in the Data folder, already loose, so nothing has to be extracted from the Windows executable.
